_comment: Citations for the Fall Back move and Desperate Escape Test core rules (10e). Wahapedia source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/

simulator.fall_back.quoted_text: A unit can make a Fall Back move in your Movement phase if it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. The unit can move up to its Move characteristic in inches and can move through enemy models when doing so. A unit that Falls Back can shoot or charge only if it has the FLY keyword.
simulator.fall_back.trigger: owning player's Movement phase; unit is within Engagement Range (1.5" in SwegHammer's continuous model) of one or more enemy units
simulator.fall_back.effect: unit moves up to M" away, may move through enemy models, and is barred from shooting and charging this turn unless it has the FLY keyword. SwegHammer sets a per-round fell_back_this_round flag on the unit and gates _do_shoot / _do_charge on (flag and not FLY).

simulator.desperate_escape.quoted_text: models can move over enemy models when making a Fall Back move as if those enemy models were not there, but you must take a Desperate Escape test for each model that will do so (excluding models that are TITANIC or can FLY). For each roll of 1-2, one model from the unit that is Falling Back is destroyed.
simulator.desperate_escape.trigger: immediately after a Fall Back move that passed through one or more enemy models; TITANIC and FLY models are entirely exempt
simulator.desperate_escape.effect: roll 1D6 per non-TITANIC non-FLY model in the falling-back unit; each result of 1-2 destroys one model. SwegHammer models units as one Unit per model, so a single D6 is rolled and on a 1-2 the unit's current_health is zeroed (one model destroyed). TITANIC or FLY units skip the test entirely.
